title: Global best practice recommendations for genetic counselling and testing in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
title_zh: 全球最佳实践建议：肌萎缩侧索硬化症的遗传咨询与检测
abstract: Abstract Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease with substantial clinical and genetic heterogeneity. Advances in ALS genomics, emerging gene-targeted therapies, and genotype-specific clinical trials have increased the importance of genetic counselling and testing for individuals with ALS and their families. However, access to these services remains highly variable globally due to disparities in healthcare infrastructure, laboratory capacity, specialist availability, and funding. Existing guidance has largely been developed in high-resource settings and may not be feasible or equitable worldwide. The International Alliance of ALS/MND Associations convened an international, multidisciplinary Genetics Task Force to develop expert consensus recommendations for genetic counselling, genetic testing, and laboratory practice in ALS across diverse geographic and resource settings. Recommendations were developed through a structured, iterative consensus process incorporating clinical expertise, lived experience perspectives, published evidence, and global representation. Final recommendations were reviewed and approved through anonymous voting at an in-person consensus meeting. The resulting recommendations establish both minimum and aspirational best practices, emphasizing equitable access, informed decision-making, culturally responsive counselling, tiered genetic testing approaches, and context-appropriate laboratory standards. These globally informed recommendations provide a pragmatic framework to support clinicians, laboratories, policymakers, and advocacy organizations in improving access to high-quality ALS genetics services worldwide.
abstract_zh: 摘要：肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进展性神经退行性疾病，具有显著的临床和遗传异质性。ALS基因组学的进展、针对基因的治疗方法的出现以及基因型特异性临床试验的开展，使得对ALS患者及其家属进行遗传咨询和检测的重要性日益提升。然而，由于医疗基础设施、实验室能力、专科医生可用性和资金等方面的差异，全球范围内对这些服务的获取仍高度不均。现有的指导方针主要在资源充足的地区制定，可能在全球范围内不可行或不公平。国际ALS/MND协会联盟召集了一个跨学科的遗传学工作组，制定了针对不同地理和资源环境下ALS遗传咨询、遗传检测和实验室实践的专家共识建议。建议通过结构化、迭代的共识过程制定，结合临床专业知识、患者经验视角、已发表证据和全球代表性。最终建议在现场共识会议上通过匿名投票审查并批准。所提出的建议既设定了最低标准，也提出了理想的最佳实践，强调公平获取、知情决策、文化响应式咨询、分层遗传检测方法以及适合当地的实验室标准。这些全球信息化的建议为临床医生、实验室、政策制定者和倡导组织提供了一个务实框架，以改善全球范围内高质量ALS遗传服务的获取。
